Caption My doctor put me on a GLP-1 and
Caption never once mentioned what it does to your
Caption gut. I had to figure that out myself
Caption at 10am on a Tuesday when I
Caption genuinely could not shit.
Caption Let me tell you what she never told
Caption me. Because nobody told me
Caption either. The shot was working and I
Caption was dropping weight.
Caption But I felt like someone had filled my
Caption gut with concrete and forgotten about it.
Caption I'd eat a few bites at dinner and
Caption feel like I'd swallowed a brick.
Caption My jeans were getting looser but I was
Caption still leaving the dinner table early.
Caption Everyone kept telling me how great I looked,
Caption and I couldn't explain it to anyone without
Caption sounding dramatic.
Caption Because from the outside, everything was
Caption working. And I genuinely thought losing the
Caption weight would fix it.
Caption My doctor told me to add more fiber,
Caption so I started mixing fiber powder into my
Caption water every morning and eating
Caption high-fiber everything.
Caption I gave it a couple of months and
Caption if anything I felt worse, still
Caption waking up every morning with my gut full
Caption of yesterday.
Caption So I went to the pharmacy and got
Caption MiraLAX. And that felt like
Caption admitting something had genuinely gone
Caption wrong. I stood in that aisle
Caption thinking I shouldn't need this,
Caption but I was desperate enough that I didn't
Caption care. It helped a little, but the moment
Caption it wore off I was right back where
Caption I started.
Caption Something was still missing.
Caption So I started doing a
Caption crazy amount of research.
Caption I must have read thirty articles,
Caption forums, medical breakdowns, all of
Caption it. And then I came across a
Caption gastroenterologist who explained
Caption exactly what GLP-1s do to the gut.
Caption He explained it like this.
Caption Your stomach is basically a muscle that
Caption contracts and pushes everything forward.
Caption But GLP-1s slow those contractions
Caption down. Think of a river slowing to a
Caption trickle. Everything behind it starts to back
Caption up, food, waste,
Caption gas with nowhere to go.
Caption And all that pressure is what you're feeling
Caption every day.
Caption It wasn't a diet problem and it wasn't
Caption something I was doing wrong.
Caption It was the gut slowdown.
Caption And my mind started racing.
Caption Was this why the fiber never did anything?
Caption Why MiraLAX only worked until it wore
Caption off? So now I knew what was causing
Caption it. But I had no idea what
Caption actually fixed the slowdown.
Caption One night I was up late scrolling a
Caption GLP-1 support group on Facebook,
Caption and a woman posted that she'd been backed
Caption up for months on Ozempic until she
Caption started using three specific ingredients
Caption together. First was apigenin
Caption from celery juice, which she said has been
Caption shown to activate the receptors in the gut
Caption wall that trigger those contractions.
Caption Second was chlorophyllin, a plant
Caption compound that binds gas-producing
Caption compounds before they build pressure.
Caption Third was a soluble prebiotic
Caption fiber, and she was specific about the type.
Caption The bulk kind in most fiber powders
Caption and gummies just piles up in a gut
Caption that's already slowed down, which is
Caption exactly why mine made things worse.
Caption She said that's why MiraLAX never stuck for
Caption her either.
Caption It's just pushing stuff out.
Caption This is actually getting the muscle to start
Caption moving again on its own.
Caption She'd been on the shot for a year
Caption and said it was the only thing that
Caption ever worked.
Caption She'd finally stopped dreading meals.
Caption I almost kept scrolling because I'd tried the
Caption celery juice thing back in
Caption 2019 and felt nothing.
Caption But she said it doesn't work on its
Caption own. You need all three
Caption together in the right ratio.
Caption She linked the one she used.
Caption It's called Motilli, and it was the
Caption only one I could find with all three
Caption in the same gummy.
Caption Everything else was just fiber with a
Caption different label.
Caption So I ordered it and changed nothing
Caption else. Same shot, same eating.
Caption Two gummies before breakfast with a glass of
Caption water. The first week, honestly,
Caption nothing happened.
Caption But by week two I was sitting through
Caption a full dinner with my husband without that
Caption pressure building once, and by week
Caption six I realized I hadn't thought about my
Caption stomach in days.
Caption That was me two months ago.
Caption Now I get through dinner without planning my
Caption exit, and I'm not mapping my day
Caption around when I might feel okay.
Caption So if you're on a GLP-1, losing the
Caption weight, and still waking up every morning
Caption backed up and wondering why nobody
Caption warned you, this is why.
Caption I'll drop the link below.
Caption If ninety days in it's not the difference
Caption you were hoping for, they give you all
Caption your money back.
